description: TRANSPORTATION_bicycle_facilities is a dataset listed in City of Austin open data portal (datahub.austintexas.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a city, published or maintained by City of Austin. The Bike Facilities data will serve as the authoritative data for any bicycle infrastructure-related reference and analysis. The Bike Facilities data includes all existing facilities, their level of comfort, as well as recommended facilities and whether they belong to the All Ages and Abilities Network. Coverage: Austin. The portal files it under the category Transportation and Mobility. Its tags are neighborhood connectivity, bike lanes, bike plan, transit, recommended facilities. The table has 14 columns. Attribution on the portal: City of Austin, Texas - data.austintexas.gov. The portal shows 2026-09-07 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-datahub-austintexas-gov-portal.
